spec_features.evidence: loop.py:91 computes gave_up=looks_like_giveup(output, issued_tool_call=bool(calls)); loop.py:105-107 `if gave_up and cfg.early_stop_on_giveup: transcript.stopped_early=True; break` actually breaks the turn loop. giveup.py looks_like_giveup returns False if a tool call was issued and otherwise matches a conservative give-up regex (both conditions enforced). cfg.early_stop_on_giveup read from config (loader.py:80, run.yaml default true).
